rationale: HybridCPDataLoaderWrapper.pad_granularity=32 must be 128 when HybridEP is on, otherwise per-CP-rank shards land at offsets that misalign HybridEP dispatcher and silently mix tokens across ranks. Detection is a static config_invariant on a module attribute under precond hybrid_ep_enabled, so P8 + pi_precond. Borderline communication vs sharding: chose sharding because the fault is the per-rank shard offset, not the collective op.
